summary: Re-verified iteration_9 fix for international-transfer freeze. All three requested flows now PASS on the mobile-web preview. (1) International transfer completes end-to-end after passcode 1234; no red-box error; inline receipt [data-testid=intl-receipt] renders with TRN='TRNHCHC23IV9FPQ' matching /^TRN[A-Z0-9]{12}$/, FPID='FP4OOZYXGHNRYQDA' matching /^FP[A-Z0-9]{14}$/, Estimated arrival '2–3 business days'; 'Back to Home' (rcpt-done) navigates to /(tabs)/home. (2) Domestic transfer receipt still shows FPID (FP0Q1RDOV53ORTFZ), TRN (TRN769VFEAUJNQNS), user-typed Reference 'Lunch', Status 'Completed', and footer 'HSBC UK | Secure Banking'. (3) Chatbot name swaps per theme — HSBC→'Ellie', Santander→'Sandy'. Minor pre-existing RN deprecation warnings persist (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) but are non-blocking.

issues: When Santander theme active, chatbot header/name swaps to 'Sandy' correctly, but the greeting subtitle still hard-codes 'Your personal HSBC banking assistant. …'. Should use the current bank theme name (or a generic phrase). Non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' React Native Web 0.19+ prefers boxShadow. Multiple StyleSheet.create blocks affected (already flagged in iteration_9).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely coming from a Modal/overlay. Move pointerEvents into the style prop (already flagged in iteration_9).

action_items: OPTIONAL (design polish): Update chat greeting subtitle to reference the active bank theme instead of hard-coding 'HSBC banking assistant' — e.g. use `${getBankTheme(bankThemeId).name} banking assistant`.
OPTIONAL (tech debt): Migrate shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents across shared components (unchanged from iteration_9).
critical_code_review_comments: Adapter/screen contract now aligns for international transfer (amount_received, estimated_arrival, trn/TRN{12}, fpid/FP{14}). A shared TS interface for `/transfers/international` response — imported by both offline-adapter.ts and international-transfer.tsx — would prevent future drift.

international-transfer.tsx submit() still doesn't wrap setReceipt() in try/catch. If a future adapter regression breaks another field, isSubmitting could remain stuck on a render throw. Consider defensive fallbacks (e.g. `res.data.amount_received ?? res.data.converted_amount ?? 0`).
seed_data_creation: Set localStorage.hsbc_customization to {bankThemeId:'santander'} to validate chatbot name swap; reset to 'hsbc' after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_9 bug is fully fixed. International transfer end-to-end works: /international-transfer → fill Alice Johnson / DE89370400440532013000 / COBADEFFXXX / DE / 100 / 'Family support' → Send → passcode 1234 → intl-receipt with rcpt-trn matching /TRN[A-Z0-9]{12}/ and rcpt-fpid matching /FP[A-Z0-9]{14}/ → rcpt-done → home. Domestic transfer + chatbot theme swap regressions PASS. Note: on web the AuthGate keypad digits are div/text nodes without testIDs — press them by finding the largest visible element with matching innerText (>=30x30 bounding box) and dispatching a bubbling click event; page.get_by_text().click() may hit a background text node (e.g. digits inside IBAN) instead.
rca_of_issue: N/A — original bug (undefined toFixed + wrong FPID prefix in offline-adapter.ts) is resolved. Adapter now returns amount_received, converted_amount, rate, trn (`TRN`+12 alnum), fpid (`FP`+14 alnum), and estimated_arrival='2–3 business days', matching what international-transfer.tsx expects.
